aiOverview.content: When managing white-label integrations and automated data exchanges with archelios PRO (developed by Trace Software), the platform relies on specific APIs and standard file formats to interoperate with external systems.The primary file formats and data standards used for white-label exports, structural transfers, and API integrations include:1. Project Topology and Native Data Exchange.arc File Format: This is the current, native format used to export complete project data (covering both AC and DC elements with preconfigured components) from archelios PRO into other engineering software, such as elec calc SOLAR..a3d (archelios 3D) File Format: Historically utilized across the archelios ecosystem to package the full 3D layout, shading profiles, and system configurations.2. Standard Technical, CAD, and GIS FormatsFor broad white-label and third-party application parsing, archelios PRO (specifically under its advanced tiers like Gold and Platinum) exports structural layout and geospatial data in industry-standard structures:For broad white-label and third-party application parsing, archelios PRO (specifically under its advanced tiers like Gold and Platinum) exports structural layout and geospatial data in industry-standard structures:DXF (Drawing Exchange Format): The primary format for exporting 2D/3D component layouts into AutoCAD or alternative white-labeled CAD engines.CSV / Excel Format: Used to export raw simulation telemetry, performance ratio estimations, and general material component breakdowns (BOM) for database ingestion.PDF Reports: Available for direct customer-facing white-label deliverables, detailing economic analysis (LCOE/VAN/TRI) and monthly production tracking.3. API Integrations and Data IngestionRather than relying solely on file transfers, modern white-label platforms interface with archelios PRO via programmatic web services:Rather than relying solely on file transfers, modern white-label platforms interface with archelios PRO via programmatic web services:JSON/REST Web Services: External APIs (such as those providing TMY meteorological data or specific mounting system catalogs) supply structural configurations directly to the archelios environment, mapping product attributes automatically into the engineering list.Are you trying to push structural layout data into archelios PRO from an external tool, or are you looking to extract simulation results out to a proprietary white-label dashboard?Are you trying to push structural layout data into archelios PRO from an external tool, or are you looking to extract simulation results out to a proprietary white-label dashboard?AI responses may include mistakes.
